name: t2-status
instruction: Before every take_action, start the notes with this line and fill it from observe: `Review in <months to the next review month> | HR <clear/risk> | Wealth <ok/low> | Left <months to 48> | Rule <which rule applies> | Pick <choice>` Months to the next review = 6 minus (current_month mod 6), and 0 when current_month is a multiple of 6. When Review in is 1, the review rule applies to every story choice.
